findings.title: Check package runtime settings and ancestry, not only source paths
findings.description: verify_source excludes package.json from protected runtime paths and only checks its version. scripts/build.mjs reads tocRevision and injects it into the bundle. A pure mock with changed tocRevision and build:firefox is accepted. verify_source also makes no ancestry check between runtimeCommit and deliveryCommit.
findings.currentDataImpact: The current catalog snapshots have already passed the independent byte/blob and package-equivalence audit, so no present runtime mismatch was found. The cloud tool does not enforce its stated test-only allowance.
findings.requestedFix: Compare runtime and delivery package JSON completely after stripping only scripts keys beginning test:. Reject all other differences and require merge-base --is-ancestor runtime delivery. Add pure drift and non-ancestor regression cases.
findings.resolution: Complete non-test package comparison and ancestry guard now reject pure counterexamples.

findings.title: Point main version-index report links at version snapshots
findings.description: The main update intentionally copies only README/version-policy/version-catalog/versions/development-plan. Existing main b1d2ea0 has no acceptance-final/v0.1.1/v0.2.0/v0.3.x or live-history-failure docs. The relative report and withdrawal links in versions.md therefore resolve to absent files on main after publication.
findings.requestedFix: Use GitHub blob links pinned to each delivery tag or full commit for acceptance reports and pin the withdrawal report to its later evidence commit. Inspect the five published docs for other links to omitted product files.
findings.resolution: Evidence links pin original delivery/later failure commits; compact main development plan contains only available relative links.

conclusion: Both identified defects resolved and independently rechecked. No remaining actionable defect found within reviewed code/catalog/doc-link scope. Cloud execution, bundle upload, workflow trigger and actual remote state still require the primary cloud result verification.
